Welcome to the course.

This file demonstrates the conventions:

- it lives in `Introduction/`, and `_modules.yml` lists that folder, so it
  becomes an item in the **Introduction** module;
- `canvas.type: page` makes it a Canvas Page, and declaring a type is also what
  includes it in the module. Its position comes from `Introduction/_order.yml`,
  or it goes last if that file does not list it. Drag it in the Course Board to
  move it;
- it starts unpublished, so it won't be visible to students until you set
  `published: true`.

Delete this file once you have real content.
